ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Heading.helper: Enter the heading to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

HeadingClasses.helper: Enter the heading classes to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Slides.helper: Add at least one slides item. You can add more items as needed.

ImageTitle.helper: Enter the image title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ImageDescription.helper: Enter the formatted content for image description. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

ImagePath.helper: Can be a local image, or an offsite web addresses

ImageAlt.helper: Describe the image for people who use screen readers. Leave this blank only when the image is decorative.
